name: split-flap
title: Split Flap
description: Each character flips through the alphabet to its value like a departure board, settling left to right; changing the value flips again.

meta.reducedMotion: Shows the new value at once.
meta.useWhen: Schedules, line-ups, menus, travel, times and short codes.
meta.avoidWhen: Long text; values the reader must trust mid-animation (the final value is announced, not the flips).
